explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/185 with the positive answer from density Hales–Jewett: f_3(n) = o(3^n), where f_3(n) is the largest subset of {0,1,2}^n with no three points collinear in ℝ^n. Forbidding all collinear triples rather than only combinatorial lines makes f_3 smaller, so the o(3^n) statement is implied by DHJ. Formal proof linked.
